candidateValidationGuardrail.meaning: A fail-closed validation threshold for this bounded candidate corpus; it is not an accuracy guarantee or oracle claim.

limitations: This corpus validates boundary-table behavior and independently locates apparent-Sun longitude crossings; it does not validate complete Four Pillars charts.
The embedded primary table minute remains the calculation boundary; the Astronomy Engine crossing is not substituted for it.
KASI provenance and Korean-methodology expert review remain pending.
The 120-second guardrail is a candidate validation threshold, not an accuracy claim.
